name: NHA Certified Medical Administrative Assistant

D7.name: Medical practice administrative procedures and logistics

realExamNote: The real CMAA exam has 110 scored and 25 unscored pretest questions (about 2 hours 15 minutes).
scoreNote: NHA uses a scaled score from 200 to 500 with 390 to pass; the timed mock exam maps percent correct onto that scale, so treat 390+ as a readiness signal, not a guarantee.
